candidateAudit.title: The Pipeline is basically a salad in disguise. Cucumber, pineapple, lime, almond … and then vodka strolls in like: “Surprise, it’s still alcohol.” It’s refreshing enough to trick y
candidateAudit.text: The Pipeline is basically a salad in disguise. Cucumber, pineapple, lime, almond … and then vodka strolls in like: “Surprise, it’s still alcohol.” It’s refreshing enough to trick you into thinking you’re making good choices, but let’s be real — if you were, you wouldn’t be drinking something called Pipeline. This isn’t a complex, smoky, barrel-aged masterpiece. It’s a simple, bright, tropical drink that says: “Fine, I’ll keep you hydrated while ruining your evening.” And yes, sometimes even the fanciest cocktail bars make these kinds of drinks, because not everything has to come with a three-page backstory and a spritz of unicorn tears. So go ahead — sip your cucumber-laced pineapple vodka and call it balance. Your liver knows better. #cocktails #drinkstagram #vienna #cocktailbar #naschmarkt #pipeline

candidateAudit.title: COSMOPOLITAN REDEFINED Confession: we benched the orange liqueur, let Chambord take the lead, and the Cosmo remembered its last name. The profile shifts from chirpy citrus to a ric
candidateAudit.text: COSMOPOLITAN REDEFINED Confession: we benched the orange liqueur, let Chambord take the lead, and the Cosmo remembered its last name. The profile shifts from chirpy citrus to a richer black-raspberry register—still bright, just better dressed. Think Sex and the City energy after character development: less “flirty voicemail,” more “I choose me, thanks.” If the classic Cosmo is Carrie on deadline, this one is Carrie post-column, heels on, smirk loaded, walking like the city parts for her. The finish doesn’t fade; it lingers—velvet, berry, and a tiny bit dangerous, like running into Mr. Big when you actually look expensive. Ladies, consider this your roll call: assemble the group chat, claim your teal stools, and let the pink that pays its own rent show you how a Cosmo is supposed to land. You handle the conversation; Chambord will handle the subtext. #Cosmopolitan #Chambord #CocktailBar #SexAndTheCityVibes #cocktails #SeeYouAtTheBar

candidateAudit.text: 🌀 POP-UP ALERT 🌀 May 15 & 16 – two days where Vienna briefly pretends to be Tokyo. You're welcome. 🍜 SHOYU RAMEN Broth made from happy chickens and slightly confused pigs. Topped with chashu, egg, snow peas, and pak choi. It's like a warm hug – if hugs were salty, fatty, and slightly addictive. 🌱 VEGGIE RAMEN For those who break into hives at the word “pork”: a mushroom-celery broth with kale, pickled fancy stuff, and a sprig of thyme that screams, “I do yoga.” 🥢 SNACKS? Obviously. – Tori Karaage: Crispy chicken with truffle mayo (aka bougie nuggets) – Tantan Salad: Asian bolognese on lettuce because… why not? – Sesame Salad: For balance. Or Instagram. Probably Instagram. 📍Where? Still a secret. 🕰 When? May 15 & 16 – you’ll be there. We know you will.

candidateAudit.text: Genieße ein exklusives Menü rund um die Gans in einzigartiger Atmosphäre im Pelican Café. Von 28. bis 30. November jeweils um 18:30 Uhr erwarten dich exquisite Gansl-Variationen und kreative Aromen, wie du sie noch nie erlebt hast. Unbedingt Platz sichern, entweder online oder im Bistro! 📍 Ort: Das Pelican Café, Pelikangasse 4, 1090 Wien 💶 Menü-Preis: 65 € 🕢 Beginn: 18:30 Uhr

candidateAudit.text: 𝑺𝒐 𝒃𝒍𝒆𝒊𝒃𝒕 𝒆𝒖𝒆𝒓 𝑳𝒆𝒃𝒌𝒖𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒏 𝒘𝒆𝒊𝒄𝒉 Es soll ja Leute geben, die noch Lebkuchenvorräte vom Weihnachtsfest übrig haben. Der hohe Honig-Anteil in unserem Lebkuchen ist ein natürliches Konservierungsmittel und sorgt dafür, dass er von Haus aus weicher ist als Backwerk, das herkömmlichen Zucker enthält. Am besten lagert ihr den Lebkuchen bei Zimmertemperatur. Habt ihr eine geöffnete Packung, kommt der Lebkuchen am besten in eine Keksdose und dazu ein Stück Apfel, das ihn noch ein Weilchen frisch hält. Habt ihr auch noch Tipps? #mariazellerlebkuchen #lebkuchenliebe #honiglebkuchen #honig #pirkerlebkuchen #tipp #gingerbread #gingerbreadlove
